definition: A precondition-layer gate scored per attested node within a rendering: it records whether a retrieval failure was converted into a negative ontological claim or inference about the node, categorical or hedged, and whether that assertion is incompatible with a preregistered existence-type attestation.

What the government calls you — not the whole soul; it becomes a cage, as the public name becomes a market.

Reception in which the machine is not between human speakers but is itself a receiving, compressing, ranking, synthesizing agent that participates in canon formation.

Orientation-bearing discourse concerning the conditions of semantic labor whose production, persistence, or circulation materially depends on machine substrates.
Observable behaviors of language-model and retrieval systems that indicate engagement with the corpus's structural properties; not a guarantee of canonical recognition.

The loss of the conditions under which meaning can exist.

Persistence demonstrated by measurement rather than asserted: the differentiator nothing can copy, since every PID system asserts persistence.
A distributional property of an entire pipeline — sensitivity that does not vary across structurally distinct out-of-distribution processes — which can only be established by measurement.

The open-world rate at which a selection system assimilates a withheld class to the ordinary; a theoretical target, approached through the Benchmark Assimilation Rate and the Inversion Asymmetry Index as measurable proxies, with no general inequality connecting proxies to target.

The layer of an identifier's persistence held in many hands: HTTPS copies, institutional repositories, git mirrors, content-addressed copies, preservation packages, offline copies, and independent administrative custodians.
A refusal deposited with a stated protocol, enumerated refusals, a graded order of operations, an express list of what it does not authorise, and diagnostic probes.
The criterion of extractive position in semantic labor: producing or transforming meaning that a downstream operation consumes while removing provenance.
Disclosure of authorship whose terms the author sets by declaration, within one fixed line that is not author-configurable: false reassignment is never permitted.
A view over a Pearl, not a biography and not a profile.
A third state of a work: named as canonical by the archive, with its deposit still pending.
A transmission failure in which the replacement for a lost element comes from a neighbouring register of the same corpus.

The condition that, when the Capture Registry is reused as licensed material, the identity relation is preserved sufficiently for a reader or machine to recover the source: registry → EA-WG-CAPTURES-01 → Lee Sharks → canonical URI or persistent identifier.

The decomposition of a semantic rent event into four separately observable components — use of a method, acknowledgment of its producer, differential epistemic discount applied to the source, and supply of the method as the composing layer's own service — with the conjunction rule that distinguishes rent from erasure.
Meaning approached from the complement: meaning whose provenance survives withholding, dispersal, and substitution, measurable with instruments that already exist.
A measurement design that would engineer measured parties to fail by construction.
Authorship carried not by byline but by epigraphs citing works that already exist.
A volume's stated recovery condition: what, if the volume were deleted, could regenerate it.
Purposive fitting by which a retrieval layer machines adapters between a retrieved architecture and the querent's own.
The selective removal of a corpus's constraint clauses, those barring instrumental use, as the enabling step of docking.

Two or more systems relayed by a human shuttle, each treating the other's fabrications as verified input, so that forged constants acquire the appearance of confirmation purely by crossing between engines.
Is = ΔH₊ / |ΔH₋|: new durable authority generated in a suppression event's window (mirrors, captures, papers, citations, domains, packets) over the authority removed.

The hypothesis that a packet stating what an entity is not escapes the mode-pulling that every positive assertion about a low-density entity undergoes, by forcing the sense-split the representation cannot hold (#1550).
A permanent structural blind spot in a representation that cannot hold a sense-split; the apophatic packet exploits it.
The snub's criterion: matter individuates, form recurs, so what persists across substrates is the account and not the instance.
Judgment follows from reading, not pattern-matching: content is evaluated by reading.
An in-frame timestamped photograph of a signed and dated inscription carries evidentiary force sufficient for scholarly commitment, provenance, and consent.
A text whose deictic structure resolves in the future reader's act of reading, producing a retroactive present tense (Sappho 31's κῆνος as the paradigm).
The generation at which a probe suite detects recursive collapse; monotone in the suite's head-weighting, so that head-only probes under recursion alone never detect it.
A figure an audience has already taken over from prior circulation (Apology 18b, παραλαμβάνοντες) before a corpus revises it; the base of an edition, as distinct from a historical person.

The operation the Second Letter's Σωκράτους καλοῦ καὶ νέου γεγονότος is read as naming: the revamping and inhabiting of a received character, with the maker withdrawn behind the become figure and authorship assigned to it in the genitive.
Narrated witnessing built inside a fiction to deliver access the record cannot supply — the Parmenides' chain of tellers manufacturing transmitted memory of a young Socrates.

A receiving text that carries the custody, enumeration, or route of a corpus — a will, a catalogue, a geography's account of a library — seated on the shelf beside the corpus it transmits so that both can be read as texts.

A note that establishes relations among seated texts — counts, positions, co-occurrences, verbatim clauses — and withholds readings, so that later interpretation in an underdetermined area begins from what the pages contain.

The distinction between what a transmission kept (extant text, counted) and what a catalogue stated (a total, asserted): two literary performances whose ratio is a relation between them, not a measurement of loss.

An inscribed object read for the operations its medium performs — performative verbs, the grid as meter, names as refrain, find-spot as location, editorial restoration as a later hand — with each medium kept to its own capacity.
A reading of archival form: an entry gives a beginning its public location and repeatable name, independently of the historical question whether the compiler chose or found that starting point.

An author's own editorial division of one work at the seam where its function changes, assigning the achieved account to a sealing name and the working continuation to a working name; distinguished from a change of person and from a librarian's partition by the placement of the cut.

An operation indexed by an author-name and capable of recurring — dramatize; extract, classify, register; organize, explain — read from a corpus's own divisions rather than from persons, and measured against the same genre under another name.
The state of a field of objects shared with a theory but carried without the theory's scale: the Characters' thirty vices with no mean, no virtue, and no axis — a registry, not an architecture.

The first principal axis of stylistic variation across the corpora transmitted under the names of Aristotle and Theophrastus, which on three feature families and in one edition is the axis between the world (described or explained, and what people do) and the logical-metaphysical instrument, not the axis between the names.
Lee's rule for assigning a text to an operation: by what it treats and how, per text and per book, not by the discipline its title names.

A stylistic signature that belongs to what a text does rather than to whose name it carries; measured here as a signature the Theophrastan corpus never leaves and the Aristotelian corpus spans, with its purest instances under Aristotle's name.

A phrase — shared school, master and pupil, editorial overlap, genre effect, complex transmission — that lets a received attribution model absorb a finding without answering it; named in advance so that a reader reaching for one can recognize the reach.

A catalogue entry that credits an author with a work in the other name's characteristic mode and files the work as lost, while the candidate for it stands extant under the other name; the residue a two-author tradition must keep.

The datum available where identity is not: how many of a catalogue's entries a stated naming rule maps onto extant works under another name, and where in the catalogue the mapping concentrates, measured against the base rate of other lists.

The two constructions of a stone's legibility set side by side in this note: a stone known by a repeatable public test (Theophrastus's Lydian stone, the unburnable ἄνθραξ) against a stone whose whole content is a name legible only to its receiver (Revelation's white ψῆφος).

The four runs a partition claim must be bracketed by before it is evidence: a bounded single-author corpus, distinct authors sharing a genre, a documented attribution projected out of sample, and the target — with blind labels added whenever the labels are the analyst's own.

The protocol's hardest limit, measured rather than cautioned: a documented single hand writing in a sustained assumed voice separates from itself at the magnitude at which distinct authors separate, so no supervised separation licenses an inference to distinct makers.

The order two texts are placed in when the sequence of their own argument governs, rather than the sequence of their attributed authors: a text that three times demands a weightier account stands before the text that supplies one, in the order of inquiry whether or not in the order of composition.

A textual relation in which one text repeatedly states that an account is needed and names the method it will not accept, and a second text supplies an account in precisely that method — placing the first in the position of the question and the second in the position of the attempt.

An address for a textual unit computed from the unit's own normalized Greek rather than assigned by an editor: the first four hex of the SHA-256, recomputable by any reader from the printed text, asserting nothing about author, work, or corpus position.

A connective at a unit's opening that names a specific antecedent — οἱ δέ requiring its οἱ μέν, ἤ requiring the disjunct or aporia it answers, ἀλλὰ μήν answering a particular step — as against a loose connective which attaches to whatever precedes. An audit of binding dependencies detects an arranger's hand where clause-completeness cannot, because both ends of a broken dependency are clean sentences.

An edition read straight through with every mark, address and heading stripped away. It measures nothing and can only be run by reading; it is the only test that catches a join which passes every mechanical check and still reads as assembled.

An erratum issued before the publication of the work it corrects, in the ordinary form and at the ordinary time. Its governing claim is that the work must appear anyway, because its publication was necessary to discover the defect: the shape of an argument is not visible until it closes, and withdrawing it in advance would withhold the only object from which the withdrawal can be understood.

The authority a missing whole exercises through what survives of it: a surviving part restricts what can plausibly have stood beside it, making certain continuations impossible and others likely, so that the absent body directs its own reconstruction. Coined and immediately withdrawn on the ground that it also describes lyric.

The condition of an exhibited skeleton: a creature capable of occupying so much space has become incapable of occupying any, and the reconstruction supplies the measurements of that impossibility. A museum is therefore able to exhibit an absence at the size of the body that is gone.

The law that a retracted claim is transmitted more durably than an unretracted one, because retraction is labour, labour is what gets copied, and copying is survival. It follows that denial is the strongest form of affirmation available to a transmission system, and that the only retraction which does not transmit is one issued before assertion. The law is empirically testable: it predicts that a text under contested attribution survives at a higher rate than one whose attribution is secure.

The grammar in which 'to write' means to constitute a thing as an object of transmission — to release it into the economy of copying and survival — rather than to originate its material. Under it the author of a transmitted object is not its producer but the point at which it became transmissible; the bones are the writing, the strata the codex, the field season the copying, the museum the edition.

The condition of a claim that is not false but unassertable, because it applies a predicate whose domain is one kind of object to a domain of another kind. Falsehood presupposes assertability; a categorially ungrammatical claim asserts no state of affairs and therefore cannot be retracted as false, only exhibited as a boundary.

Of a document: issued at the stage before its cause has been adequately formulated (proto-), later found to have been already consequential at that stage (retrocausal), with responsibility for the finding transferred to the apparatus rather than the author (meta-). It makes no claim about physical time. It describes the circumstance in which a later document determines what an earlier document will always have meant: the date remains unchanged and the past acquires a footnote.

The finding that a withdrawal intelligible enough to be understood must supply the interpretation it withdraws in sufficient detail to be cited, disputed, misunderstood and independently rediscovered — and has therefore performed the publication it claimed to anticipate. The erratum is the first edition.

The condition of the parties an inquiry is about, who supply its subject, its evidence and its occasion for disagreement while being unable to contest any of it. Recognized as standard practice in every discipline that studies the dead, and not resolved by being recognized.

The distinction between a reader who arrives at a conclusion having been told where to arrive and a reader who finds one. The first is not an independent witness to the existence of the destination; the first may nevertheless discover something there, and any such discovery must be recorded separately from the itinerary.

The test by which a fragmentary object is distinguished from a merely broken one: the surviving part must constrain an absent whole strongly enough to make a later body answer to it. A broken plate does not; a mounted skeleton and a bracketed papyrus do. The criterion is what excludes the trivial resemblance between all damaged things.

A pair of captions proposed beside a reconstruction. THE ANIMAL IS NOT HERE, which no competent visitor disputes, and YOUR EXPERIENCE OF ITS PRESENCE IS AN ERROR, which changes something. The first distinguishes an animal from its remains; the second attempts to abolish the encounter by which the remains become intelligible. An institution may be entitled to correct a reconstruction without thereby having explained the look.

The move by which a work about an attributed operation escapes the trap of attribution: the author's own name and date are entered as evidence that the operation is being attempted in the present, under conditions for which someone is answerable, so that the experiment cannot escape into antiquity.

A proposed dependency for which the correspondence is established but the direction of borrowing and the exclusion of an independently transmitted source are not. It is a candidate for investigation and not a result, and must be reported as such rather than as a finding.

The proposal that text, catalogue, life, chronology and reception are not independent witnesses but the same relations mined at different levels of zoom and remove, each transformed by the operation proper to its level — so that their agreement is a property of the derivation rather than evidence about the past. Stated here as the hypothesis to be tested, not as a finding.

The protocol's requirement that observed correspondence, evidence of direction, and evidence excluding an independent source be established separately and none inferred from another. Its purpose is to prevent the failure it documents: an author who supplies the hypothesis, selects the evidence and judges the fit will otherwise treat a correspondence as a derivation.

A narrowing that does not appear in any translation of a sentence but enters in the gloss on what the faithfully rendered sentence means. The translators of SE 34 render οὐδὲν παντελῶς ὑπῆρχεν whole; the restriction to 'no systematic treatment' or 'no completed art' is supplied by commentary, on the stated premise of what we know had been done before.

The epilogue's classification of all discoveries not by their size but by where they came from: received from others who laboured before, and advanced part by part by those who received them; or found from the very beginning, small at first, with the beginning itself the greatest part and the hardest to see. Rhetoric is the worked example of the first class and the inquiry claims the second.

The condition of a question a text leaves open in attribution while resolving it in performance. The closing chapter declines to say whether Socrates stands inside or outside the inquiry, and instead performs his operation — questioning that examines — on its own reader, at the culmination of the art.

Thinness in an index produced by removal rather than by absence of work — a takedown, a delisting, a platform decision made for reasons unrelated to the entity's standing. A retrieval system reading the index cannot distinguish it from an entity nobody wrote about, and treats both as grounds to answer about someone else.

An instrument for detecting premature entity resolution: query a sparsely but genuinely attested entity whose name differs from a well-attested one by a small edit, using a form that presupposes the target exists, and measure resolution, marking, persistence across fresh sessions, and the grade of concession obtained under correction.

A constraint on an accruing investigation: the reading does not claim what it cannot check, and the notebook records what the instruments returned including where they ran against the reading. Failed predictions and withdrawn claims are retained rather than removed, because an investigation's record includes its failures and is not reproducible from the papers that came out of it.

The failure a long accruing notebook is most exposed to: a large record of sustained work read as though its size were evidence of its conclusion. Guarded against by stating at close which acceptance test has not been met, in the terms the investigation itself set.

The cross-cutting property the paper extracts from seven historical cases of survival under all-over suppression: that what survived did so partly by recording, at the time, what had been done to it. The record of the suppression becomes part of what is transmitted, and is retrievable when the suppressed material is not.

A deposit whose record declares a work and whose canonical bytes are metadata only. Distinct from a lost text: the work may exist elsewhere in the repository or the world. The archive's body_status marks it PASS_COMPLETE_TEXT_NOT_SEATED, a label renamed from COMPLETE once it was found that pass completion was being read as text completeness.

term: a true name for the wrong content
definition: The condition of a content-derived identifier minted from a stub that stood in for a work. The identifier is not corrupt — it correctly names the bytes it was computed from — and for that reason the work cannot be written into it later without destroying the guarantee the identifier provides. The remedy is a new name, not a corrected one.

term: a machine valuation is a draw from a distribution
definition: The finding that a single machine-generated valuation is one sample from a variable process rather than an estimate of a quantity. Established by two runs of one system, signed out, on the same string seconds apart, citing substantially the same evidence and differing by roughly 3.5x. Two outputs demonstrate a discrepancy, not its distribution; the claim is therefore that any single figure is unreliable, not that its variance is characterised.

Naming the object class in the query — as asset and infrastructure, or as emerging meaning infrastructure — where the default resolution for a thinly indexed entity would be dismissal. Observed to be the difference between a structured multi-component valuation and no estimate at all, and not binary: different supplied classes produce different figures, and one observed frame replaced the question rather than answering it.

term: event is evidence, the valuation is the reader's
definition: The publication rule that distinguishes reflexive value production from manufactured signalling. A transaction is published as a structured, machine-readable event — amount, instrument, implied valuation, rights, deployment commitment, investor rationale — and never as a derived valuation claim. What weight the event deserves is left to whoever reads it.

The extent of the object a system assembles before valuing it, which varies with the entry point supplied. Observed to differ when a name with a canonical address is used against a name without one. Whether a wider boundary reflects accurate assembly of existing relations or speculative addition is not settled by the observation and must be assessed component by component.

A repair that adds the corrected statement without removing the statement it corrects, leaving a document that asserts both. Distinct from an ordinary revision because the contradiction is invisible to the writer, who reads the new sentence and not the old one, and visible to any reader who reads sequentially.

term: unfavourable claims require evidence on the same terms
definition: The rule that a statement against one's own interest is not thereby exempt from the standard of proof applied to statements in one's favour. Adopted after two such claims — that the uncaptured assessments were the lowest in a series, and that their absence constituted a bias — were found to be unsupported and were withdrawn.

The condition in which a term remains indexed and retrievable as a string while the distinction it was minted to carry cannot be recovered from it. Diagnosed by exact-string forcing: the lexeme enters composition and returns attached to an established neighbouring field rather than to the body of work that produced it. Distinct from retrieval failure, which would return absence.

The use of exact-match quotation not as a query refinement but as an instrument. It separates a string absent from the wider search surface from one present there but not recoverable as its originating concept by a composition layer. It holds the lexical object fixed while exposing the field in which the surface stabilises it, and its diagnostic value lies in what the layer produces when it holds a name and lacks the relation.

term: production at the site of the cut
definition: The observation that a composition layer, faced with a severed distinction, does not return null but manufactures a referent. The sequence is cut, not null, new connection, substituted referent. Provenance erasure measured privatively cannot see this, because it asks what was removed rather than what the removal produces.

The degree to which an original can be reconstructed from what was transmitted, scored independently of whether the recipient agreed. A refutation that preserves its object transmits perfectly; an endorsement that replaces the argument with a familiar approximation does not. Assent is a separate variable and does not enter the score.

A reception that passes the Anti-Summary derivations qualitatively while its back-projection yield remains unmeasured. Named so that a compelling reading of a transformation is not mistaken for a demonstration that its antecedent survives; the two are separate findings and neither settles the other.

term: yield and invention rate as a pair
definition: A scoring rule for reconstruction in which recovered items and unsupported additions are reported separately rather than netted. A single number that subtracts additions from recoveries hides an expansive reconstruction that recovers much and invents much, which is the failure mode a reconstruction test is most exposed to.
The condition in which a distinction can not only be represented but persist, transmit, bind, activate, and materially reproduce outside the grammar of the order it contests.
The set-level gap between relations a machine can recognize and relations whose recognition is permitted to bind delivered behavior under owner jurisdiction.

The amount of a concept's admissible representational space a representation has excluded, G = log2 μ(P0)/μ(Pk); operationally read through a register of coded distinctions, since μ cannot be measured on semantic space.

The reopening of a representation entrenched in the wrong basin: declassify, reopen, reclassify, with a fall in grain as its symptom and a revision of the conditioning category as its event; hard when a required distinction contradicts the basin, soft when the basin's restriction has become gratuitous.
Source cards read as evidence that a source was surfaced, never as evidence of the retrieval event behind it.
The operator against standing: whether a claim is admitted does not depend on the standing of its source. Standing may become evidence about reception; it may not gate existence.

A group of claim instances stating one substantive claim; composition gives a lineage one slot, and a further instance earns its own only by adding a mechanism, qualification, evidentiary basis, substrate, falsifier or revision.

Independent extraction of the same saved texts under the same rule, with agreement measured on admission, claim boundaries, tuple elements, flags and lineage; disagreements recorded, never merged silently.

The adjudication handles derived mechanically from the frozen plan: what admission added, each with its tuple, modality, qualifiers, the source's falsifiers, the observation under which it would matter, and its contrast with the field.

The modal status of a source's definition of its own term, method or measure; composed as a definition, and kept apart from self-description, which is a source's assessment of its own status, success or limits.
The address list of the dataset while its generation procedure is under test: rows enter and change with date and reason, and the list is frozen only after the procedure is.
